newsitem.title: USA: PG&E Energy Services buys consulting firm.
newsitem.headline: PG&E Energy Services buys consulting firm.

text.p: PG&E Energy Services, the unregulated marketing subsidiary of PG&E Corp, announced Tuesday it has acquired Barakat & Chamberlin Inc, a national consulting and analysis firm based in Oakland, Calif.
The company said the acquisition is part of efforts to expand retail operations nationwide, as the energy industry moves forward with deregulation.
Barakat & Chamberlin (BCI) is an economic and management consulting firm in the energy, water, solid waste, cable communications and insurance industries.
The acquisition also includes Creston Financial Group, a consulting subsidiary of Barakat & Chamberlin specializing in equity and debt placements as well as mergers, acquisitions and investments.
PG&E Energy Services markets natural gas and electricity, along with customized energy services, to commerical and industrial customers.
